title: Validate @fmmenchi/ui themes
description: Validates [data-theme] CSS files against the INSTALLED @fmmenchi/tokens contract (completeness, parsable colors, sRGB gamut, WCAG contrast on every declared pair). Palette references are resolved against the reference stylesheet underneath, so a theme may point its roles at rungs.

themes.description: Workspace-relative paths of the theme CSS files to validate.

tokensPath.description: Path to the reference vars.css, for when @fmmenchi/tokens cannot be resolved from the workspace root. Escape hatch only — normally the installed package is used.
